notes.title: Minor Update - Planet Behaviour
notes.content:
Planets now need to stay outside the border for one second before drifting away.
This counters seemingly random planet losses and makes riskier merges a bit saver than before.
However this does not apply if the planet never enters the border.

notes.title: Badges, Weekly Challenges & more -- Wakusei Update v1.1
notes.content:
Badges can be unlocked by spending your hard earned points in the shop and add an extra flex to your highscore.

Introducing weekly challenges: Every week a new challenge awaits you with different unique modifiers and powers identical for everyone. Climb to the top of the highscore list each week!

Here's everything that's new and has changed:
[list]
[*] Added new weekly challenge mode
[*] Badges can now be unlocked via the shop and get displayed next to your name in the highscore list
[*] Restructured main menu for better and easier navigation
[*] Different score multiplier
[*] Score popups are now more readable
[*] Changed prices for game modes
[*] Fixed point farming exploits
[*] Balanced the appearance rate of some comets
[*] Adjusted the shockwave behaviour and size of the death laser
[*] Multiple bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Progress Saving
notes.content:
Not a huge update but with a super useful addition!
[list]
[*] Added saving the progress of running games individually and loading saved progress once you start playing again
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]
Have fun grinding for the ultimate highscore over multiple play sessions now!
